observations.lecture-01: Desktop and narrow reading/quiz refreshed screenshots rechecked. Balanced heading now uses two substantive lines; no orphan character. Question and answer hierarchy remains clear.
observations.lecture-02: Refreshed narrow hero, reading and quiz rechecked. Both former orphan-character headings now use balanced substantive lines. No new overlap or clipping.
observations.lecture-03: Refreshed narrow reading, quiz and supplement rechecked. Branch/merge/rebase supplement is readable and retains explicit official-lecture attribution, immediately followed by the branch-reference video frame and its original-video label.
observations.lecture-04: Refreshed narrow hero, reading and quiz rechecked; hero no longer leaves a single character on its last line. jj supplement was also reopened and remains adjacent to working-copy slide with readable provenance.
observations.lecture-06: Key terms are selectively emphasized. Desktop and narrow quiz separate question, control, answer and return link. Business-data supplement and slide 44 are adjacent; image container does not crop the slide.
observations.lecture-07: Desktop headings and summary align. Narrow login title wraps in two lines. Slide follows explanation. Long quiz questions wrap; opened answer is readable.
observations.extra-ai-slop: EX identity is clear. Narrow source image retains complete image aspect; caption identifies original avatar obstruction. Text-only editorial supplement is complete without an unrelated image. Quiz hierarchy is clear.

positive_findings: No text overlap, horizontal clipping or layout-induced image cropping observed in reviewed samples.
Questions use strong dark type on green; answers use a separate cream panel, label and return link.
Main prose, takeaways, navigation, captions and provenance are visually differentiated.
Dense slides become small at narrow width; the detail-view affordance is visible, but zoom was not interacted with during this review.
boundaries: 31 screenshots directly viewed; not every section or source image was examined.
Screenshot appearance does not verify interaction, default details state, browser console, native print, screen reader or real mobile devices.
Quiz screenshots show first answer expanded and later answers collapsed; behavior needs separate browser verification.
Supplement screenshots are element captures: edge-to-edge cropping does not mean the full page lacks margins.
Screenshots ending partway through a figure are viewport captures, not proof of image cropping.
Later edits still require reviewing affected screenshots; unchanged hashes preserve initial visual review evidence, not a new pixel inspection.
